caveats.en: Mackie says its Windows drivers are x64-only and 'will not install or function correctly' on Snapdragon/Arm PCs, since hardware drivers can't be emulated. No Arm driver is announced.
caveats.zh-TW: Mackie 表示其 Windows 驅動程式只有 x64 版，在 Snapdragon/Arm 電腦上「無法安裝或正常運作」，因為硬體驅動程式無法模擬。尚未宣布 Arm 版驅動。

evidence.title: Mackie: why the Windows driver won't install on Snapdragon/Arm PCs
